description: Install the personal-memory blueprint from a GitHub URL in a fresh project, then show what it put in the graph: 23 object types and four agents. The panel mixes the two steps with the three results, so the video answers both 'how do I install one' and 'what do I get'.

checklist.title: Install, then check
checklist.subtitle: Two steps in, three results out.

intro.title: Install a blueprint
intro.subtitle: The personal-memory blueprint: six schema packs, 23 object types and four agents, installed from a GitHub URL.
bullets: The URL is the whole install

outro.title: That is the install
outro.subtitle: The same URL installs the same graph, and every type and agent it adds is visible in the app.

steps.name: a fresh project
steps.caption: A new project: no agents yet, and no object types of its own.

steps.name: the blueprints gallery
steps.caption: Open Blueprints — the schema packs this project has installed.

steps.name: open the import dialog
steps.caption: Choose Import. A blueprint is installed from a repository, not an upload.

steps.name: import it
steps.caption: Import creates, publishes and applies the blueprint in one step.

steps.name: the blueprint is installed
steps.caption: personal-memory v4.1.1 is installed, and can be updated from the same URL.

steps.name: the schema is what arrived
steps.caption: Schema is what arrived: 23 object types, compiled into the graph.

steps.name: four agents are ready
steps.caption: And four agents are ready to run against those types.
